title: Standardization without NaN
task: Implement column statistics and zero-variance guard. Compare output with a constant column and assert shape, mean and variance.
acceptance_criteria: Constant column output is zero; other columns have mean 0 and std 1.

title: Capacity-aware classification
task: Load Wisconsin benchmark and select threshold under validation review capacity. Compare validation precision/recall at several thresholds, freeze threshold, evaluate test once.
acceptance_criteria: Validation review fraction <= 0.4; test may differ. Educational benchmark only, not clinical use.

title: Cross-validated regression
task: Compare median baseline with ridge penalties using development folds. Record CV MAE, selected candidate and independent test MAE.
acceptance_criteria: Select minimum development MAE; no test-based selection. Educational benchmark only.

title: XOR and nonlinear networks
task: Fit linear and nonlinear classifiers to the four XOR points. Record both accuracies and explain representational limits.
acceptance_criteria: MLP fits all four points; linear model cannot. This is not a generalization benchmark.

title: CPU CNN on handwritten digits
task: Train a small CNN on 8x8 digit images and save best validation checkpoint. Record validation and holdout macro F1, parameter count, and confusion analysis extension.
acceptance_criteria: Model returns 10 logits; test F1 between 0 and 1. Compare architecture on validation only.

title: Bounding box IoU and class-aware NMS
task: Calculate overlap and suppress duplicate same-class detections. Verify identical, disjoint, partial overlap, and different classes.
acceptance_criteria: Partial overlap 1/7; duplicate same class suppressed; other class retained.

title: Grounded retrieval and abstention
task: Use lexical retrieval against synthetic tenant-scoped policy corpus. Run fixture queries; add paraphrases and inspect false abstains. Compare a better retriever on a new holdout.
acceptance_criteria: 16 known fixtures pass; exact-match-like lexical benchmark is not real semantic evaluation.

title: Bounded corrective retrieval and claim verification
task: Implement three evidence routes and retry-bounded fact verifier. Test weak/ambiguous/strong evidence, missing fallback and permanent failure.
acceptance_criteria: Max 3 attempts; evidence mismatch abstains or corrects. Inspired by CRAG, not paper reproduction.

title: HITL and idempotency contract
task: Use SQLite receipt keys to reject unauthorized writes and replay duplicate requests. Verify deny, approve, duplicate, conflicting payload and stored row count.
acceptance_criteria: Only one authorized fixture receipt persisted; actual external exactly-once not claimed.

title: FastAPI validation and streaming
task: Create a fake inference API and SSE endpoint. Exercise successful request, invalid body, timeout, unavailable provider and event framing.
acceptance_criteria: 200,422,504,503 and valid SSE; live cancellation is a separate exercise.

title: LoRA adapter mechanics
task: Train rank-2 adapter on a frozen linear layer. Compare loss and confirm base tensor unchanged; calculate parameter count for larger layer.
acceptance_criteria: Training loss decreases, base weight unchanged; tiny toy rank is not parameter-efficient.

title: Fail-closed deployment gate
task: Evaluate candidate metrics against explicit quality and latency thresholds. Test good candidate, regression, missing metrics and emit manifest.
acceptance_criteria: Bad or incomplete candidate cannot promote.

title: Rolling demand forecast
task: Use synthetic retail CSV for three chronological backtests. Compare seasonal-naive and moving-average MAE at fixed horizons.
acceptance_criteria: Every forecast follows training cutoff; no future features.

title: Scoped memory lifecycle
task: Implement isolated memory records and expiry. Test add/update/search/delete, expiry and cross-tenant denial.
acceptance_criteria: No cross-tenant access; expired/deleted entries excluded. Not a vector DB or Mem0 test.

title: Tool contract before MCP transport
task: Build strict read-only catalog tool dispatch. Test valid input, invalid schema, unknown tool, missing scope and record not found.
acceptance_criteria: Five contract cases pass. Actual MCP integration remains separate.

title: RAG evaluation metric decomposition
task: Calculate evidence recall, abstention and human-labeled claim support separately. Use three fixture cases and explain why metrics diverge.
acceptance_criteria: Recall .5, abstention 1, support 1/3; no model judge.
